# What Lyric Actually Is

I'll be honest. Most company "About" pages bore me. They're written to impress, and they all blur together by the second paragraph. Lyric isn't most companies, so let me tell you our story my way.

When we started five years ago, the hardest hill was never the technology. It was getting people to think differently. We were never going to be a rinse and repeat of the vendors already out there. Lyric Studio was, and still is, a vision of a different way of deciding.

Think of a supply chain as a machine for making decisions. Thousands a day. What to buy, where to make it, who gets served first when there isn't enough to go around. Most companies make those decisions on software built twenty years ago, set up once in a painful implementation, then bent out of shape by every reorg and strategy pivot since. Nobody planned it that way. It's just what happens.

We built Lyric on a belief that felt almost too simple to say out loud. These are math problems. Data had become abundant, compute cheap, the algorithms far more powerful. Treat your supply chain as a math problem instead of a software purchase, and you pull ahead. Think Amazon. Think Walmart.

The belief was right, and the proof keeps arriving. **Billion-dollar networks solved end to end. Nine-figure savings. Problems the biggest names circled for decades, solved in weeks. I'd rather you hear those from our customers directly, in their words instead of mine.**

2026 changes the slope. AI now lets us invent algorithms in weeks, not years, and lets a planner ask in plain English and get real optimization back. And honestly, it's happening faster than we dared to model.

The old world forced a choice: rigid software built for the average company, or years building your own. But nothing says your decision-making has to freeze the day the software ships. Soon teams will expect it to be a living thing, reshaped in weeks, from their biggest network questions to tonight's decisions. That's what we're building toward, and why we show up every morning.

People ask if the hard part is behind us. It isn't. Most supply chain decisions are still made on spreadsheets and gut, by people who earned their skepticism through failed implementations and a fresh wave of AI-washing. It's deserved. Earning trust is harder than inventing algorithms, and it's the real work ahead.

Which brings me to what I'm proudest of. Our customers, who took a chance on a new approach when it was easier not to. And our Chorus, the people who show up to build it every day. You are the reason we get to dream this big.

If any of this resonates, come build it with us.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a5c919e97f2467acf56fdc4_title.svg)

GANESH RAMAKRISHNA

FOUNDER & CEO

## How did we get here?

2013–20

### The first record

Before Lyric, this founding team built Opex Analytics (later acquired by LLamasoft and then Coupa), a data science company solving tough supply chain problems for Fortune 500 organizations around the world. Think; same team. Bigger vision. Even more ambition to build what the industry actually needs.

2021

### The hook

The idea came to life, and one conviction sat under all of it. Enterprise supply chains deserve math they can trust applied specifically for their organization. Not yet another black box. But math-first, composable, and made for enterprise scale.

2022

### The Chorus assembles

The founding team came together and began to build. The first customers were logging into Lyric Studio before we even had business cards.

2023

### Soundcheck

Early adopters put real supply chains into production on Lyric Studio. Soon, some of the most demanding operations in the world were trusting it with the decisions their business runs on.

2024

### Curtain up

Out of stealth, and into the market. Lyric Studio made itself known in the market with the value it was creating for customers, becoming known as a vision for the next gen of supply chain decision-making.

2025

### Labels sign on

Backed by the best. A $55.5M Series B, more than $80M raised to date, and revenue up 500%. The investors who back category leaders put their weight behind Lyric.

2026

### Headlining arenas

Today, 40+ Fortune 500 brands run their supply chains on Lyric Studio. A 300+ team of Chorus members keeps them running, from Palo Alto and Chicago to Amsterdam, Chennai, and Bangalore.

Ahead

### Going platinum

What comes next is algorithms and agents making enterprise decisions at the speed the world moves. We call it the Decision Era, and we intend to lead it.

## Five things we don’t compromise on.

Trusted problem solvers

We go after the problems others hesitate to touch. Complex, high-stakes, no obvious answer. Lyric Studio is how we solve them, and we see it through until it works. We measure ourselves by nothing but the value we create for your business.

Math, not magic

The best decision wins on proven facts and evidence. The same inputs always produce the same provable answer. And you can always see through our math: a glass box, never a black box.

Composable by design

Change is built into how we work. Lyric Studio adapts to any supply chain, and we serve the market, and evolve with the same agility. Composability is not just our architecture. It is our mindset.

Mach 10

Speed is our muscle, and we train it. We ship, learn, and improve fast, with discipline: quick because we practice, precise because we prepare. We run right up to the limit, never past it. Momentum stays in our control, and speed never costs the quality we promise. That shows up as faster deployments, faster answers, and value you feel from week one.

Compassionate candor

We say what needs to be said, with the care people deserve. With each other, with our customers, and with the market. Helping customers grow and drive value paired with compassion is how we build teams worth trusting and relationships that last.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a5cb68323b7b3e0368e8d38_Frame%203.avif)

## The people who set the tempo.

A lifetime on the problem, and the passion hasn't faded. The leadership team at Lyric goes back more than a decade together, across multiple ventures and some of the hardest problems in supply chain. With over 20 years working alongside the world's largest global supply chains, the proof is in the work. And they're not done yet.
